title: A skills section that *actually helps your resume ✍️
description:
If your resume skills section is just a collection of random words you *think will help your qualifications here's what to do instead. Look at the job description for the role you're applying to and use the hard skills for the role in your skills section. Ideally these should also be used in resume achievements as well, but those hard skills can go here as well. #resumetips #resume #resumebuilder #jobsearching
